records.name: React UTable
records.purpose: Render tabular data with sorting, filtering, selection, editing, grouping, pagination and optional virtual scrolling.
records.surface: UTable<T> renders value and columns (UTableColumn<T>: field, header, optional body). UTableProps<T> exposes dataKey, sortMode, sortField, sortOrder, multiSortMeta, onSort, filters, onFilter, selectionMode, selection, onSelectionChange, compareSelectionBy, selectionColumn, paginator, first, rows, totalRecords, onPage, virtualScrollerOptions, lazy, onLazyLoad, editMode, editingRows, onRowEditChange, onRowEditInit, onRowEditSave, onRowEditCancel, cellEditValidator, onCellEditComplete, onCellEditCancel, expandedRowKeys, onExpandedRowKeysChange, onRowExpand, onRowCollapse, rowGroupMode, groupRowsBy and loading. UTableSortEvent is source-exported but omitted from the public barrel. onFilter and the cell-edit callbacks and validator are accepted but not invoked. Sort, selection and pagination are controlled; row editing and expansion have internal fallbacks. The table composes UPaginator and UScroller; virtualization renders the filtered value separately and keyboard navigation reaches mounted rows. custom filtering returns false. tableStyleModule composes @ultimate/uix-styles/table; equals and types come from @ultimate/uix-data and deepEquals from @ultimate/uix-utils/object. tableStyleModule is a source-only adapter, not a public barrel export. The family uses useComponentBase from react-core/base, whose implementation calls useComponentStyle from react-core/styling. No separate base class, props factory, directive, context/provider or exported hook exists under this family root. Root @ultimate/react and secondary @ultimate/react/table expose the same named barrel surface; declared dist artifacts do not prove publication. Aura has no matching family registration at this revision. Component metadata references this React source; metadata is not runtime integration.
